title: 第12章 学着做饭第13章 白胡子老爷爷
slug: 剑里乾坤第3107章不似作伪
content_zh:
到了晚上，高碧柔看着老蔡买来的东西，一时之间不知道该如何下手，虽然她今天也看见翠姐是怎么做饭的了！看起来很简单，可是怎么轮到自己去做的时候，都不知道该怎么下手了！她急的团团乱转，一时拿起这个，一会拿起那个，就在这时老蔡走过来说道“夫人，我来吧！”
只见老蔡先去打了一桶水，然后把买来的菜都洗了一遍，又把米淘干净，高碧柔在旁边把这些都记在心里，她不想什么事情都依靠蔡叔，她想以后自己去做这些家务事！在老蔡的一通忙乎下，他们终于吃上了，在这个新家的第一顿饭，虽然很简单，也谈不上什么厨艺，但是他们吃的很香，吃饭的时候，高碧柔把她爹给的那张一万两银票拿出来，他递到老蔡面前说道“蔡叔！这张银票您放在身上，以后家里有什么支出什么的你就看着办！”老蔡看了看高碧柔说道“还是放在夫人身上吧！我要用会和你说的！”高碧柔说道“蔡叔！这么多年我和正刚一直把您当成自己父亲一样看待，如今这种情况，我一个妇道人家也没有主见了！今后就仰仗您老了！所以您不要推辞了，我们在这生活总不能坐吃山空吧？这银子您拿去做点生意，或者买点地吧！您自己看着办！”老蔡见高碧柔这样说，也就没推辞把银票收进怀里，他说道“夫人！我抽时间去银号把这张银票兑换成面额小一点的，留一部分你继续收着，我拿一部分去做生意，再买点地！”高碧柔点头说道“蔡叔！你看着办吧！我累了，先带然儿去休息了！”说完她就带着卓然回到房间了。
第二天一早，老蔡早早就赶着马车去找刘五了，他让刘五帮忙打听一下，附近能不能买点地，刘五见他赶着马车就问道“蔡老哥！你来我这里还赶马车啊？”老蔡说道“我今天还要去镇上买点东西，所以才赶车出来的！”刘五说道“我今天也没有什么事情，和你一起去镇上上去看看热闹！”两人驾着马车很快就来到镇上，他和刘五在街上随便转悠了一圈，找了一家银号把银票兑换成小面额的银票，老蔡和刘五说道“刘五兄弟我想看看有什么生意可以做，你有什么建议吗？”刘五说道“做生意我不懂！”老蔡呵呵一笑也没多说，老蔡顺便买了不少生活必需品，又买了不少吃的东西，回来的时候马车上面装的满满的，来到刘五家的时候，老蔡说道“刘五兄弟！喊上你媳妇，今天去我们那里吃，顺便也让你媳妇教一下我家夫人做饭！”刘五说道“行啊！我进去喊我媳妇，你等我们一会！”他屁颠屁颠的跑进去，没有一会时间就拉着媳妇出来了，两人坐上马车，老蔡一扬马鞭，马车就向村西头走去，很快就到了小院门口，高碧柔带着卓然正在院子里面玩耍，见马车到了门口，她们两人也走了出来，翠姐看见高碧柔出来就说道“表妹！我今天过来和你一起做饭！”高碧柔正在犯愁怎么做饭，此时如同见到救星一般！”连声说道“这样太好了！求之不得！”小卓然已经帮忙把马车上的东西向院子里面拿了，老蔡把吃的东西拿到厨房，他出来对高碧柔说道“夫人这里不用你忙了，和你表姐去厨房吧！”
翠姐拉着高碧柔的手就向厨房走去，一边走还一边说道“妹子！今天姐好好教你怎么做饭！”高碧柔说道“我今天一定好好学！”小卓然则跟着老蔡和刘五，把马车里面的东西向房间里面拿，老蔡看着小卓然爱怜的摸了摸他的头，眼里充满了关爱！很快东西就全部搬下去归置好了。老蔡沏了一壶茶，和刘五就休闲的喝起了茶，小卓然则自己跑到院子里面玩耍，老蔡说道“刘五兄弟！我和你说的事情你要尽快帮我打听一下，这里你熟悉，我们不熟悉，我们已经在这里安家了，就要想办法养活自己呀！虽然手里有点钱，我们也不能坐吃山空啊！”刘五喝了一口茶水说道“蔡老哥你放心，我会尽力去办这事的，你如果还想去镇上做点生意，有时间可以去找我那本家兄弟聊聊！”两人一边喝着茶一边闲聊着，小卓然一会跑到房间里面，一会跑到厨房里面，玩的很是开心！厨房里面高碧柔跟在翠姐后面虚心的学习做饭做菜，翠姐也是不厌其烦的告诉她，红烧鸡块怎么做，小炒肉怎么做，她居然让高碧柔亲手做了一个炒鸡蛋，这让高碧柔有点激动，好像自己做了什么人间美味似的！老蔡和刘五听着厨房传出来的声音相视一笑，继续闲聊着！他们居然争论起了酒的好坏！
就在这时翠姐端着一盆红烧鸡块走了进来，那香味瞬间就充满了房间，高碧柔紧接着把炒鸡蛋也端了上来，她还对两人说道“这个鸡蛋我炒的，待会你们一定要尝尝！”很快桌子上面就摆了六道菜，翠姐说道“可以开始吃了！”老蔡和刘五自然而然的把酒就拿了上来，他们倒上酒，高碧柔和翠姐这时也过来坐了下来，小卓然也一本正经的坐在妈妈身边，高碧柔夹了一块鸡肉放到卓然的碗里，老蔡则举起酒杯敬了刘五一杯，高碧柔和翠姐今天则没喝酒，她们两人每人装了一碗米饭，这顿饭高碧柔吃的特别香，因为这是她感觉自己有了很大的进步，里面有一个菜，炒鸡蛋还是她在翠姐的指导下自己动手做的，很有成就感，反正她自己吃的很香！
吃完饭以后，高碧柔和翠姐一起收拾了一下，然后翠姐就拉着高碧柔聊了起来，高碧柔是越来越喜欢性格大大咧咧的翠姐了！她一边陪着翠姐聊天，一边看着卓然在院子里面玩耍。老蔡和刘五聊了一会，就起身告辞带着还想聊的翠姐离开了这里，他要找人打听一下谁家有地要卖，因为他答应老蔡了！
content_en:
At night, Gao Birou looked at the things Lao Cai bought and didn't know how to start for a while, although she also saw how Sister Cui cooked today! It seems very simple, but when it's my turn to do it, I don't know where to start! She was running around in a hurry, picking up this thing and that thing. At this moment, Lao Cai came over and said, "Madam, let me do it!"
I saw Lao Cai first fetching a bucket of water, then washing all the vegetables he bought, and washing the rice. Gao Birou kept all this in mind. She didn't want to rely on Uncle Cai for everything. She wanted to do these housework by herself in the future! After Lao Cai's busy work, they finally had their first meal in their new home. Although it was very simple and did not involve any cooking skills, they ate very deliciously. While eating, Gao Birou took out the 10,000 taels of silver note given by her father. He handed it to Lao Cai and said, "Uncle Cai! You can take this bank note." Keep it with you, and you can take care of the family expenses in the future!" Lao Cai looked at Gao Birou and said, "Let's keep it with you!" Gao Birou said, "Uncle Cai! For so many years, Zhenggang and I have treated you as our own father. In this situation, I am alone. I have no idea anymore! I will rely on you from now on! So don’t refuse, we can’t live in vain here, right? You can use this money to do some business or buy some land!” Seeing Gao Birou say this, Lao Cai took the money in his arms and said. "Madam! I'll take the time to go to the bank and exchange this bank note for a smaller denomination. You can keep some of it while I'll use some to do business and buy some land!" Gao Birou nodded and said, "Uncle Cai! You figure it out! I'm tired, so I'll take Ran'er to rest first!" After that, she took Zhuo Ran back to the room.
Early the next morning, Lao Cai drove a carriage to find Liu Wu. He asked Liu Wu to help find out if he could buy some land nearby. When Liu Wu saw him driving the carriage, he asked, "Brother Cai! Why are you driving a carriage when you come to my place?" Lao Cai said, "I have to go to the town to buy something today, so I drove the carriage out!" Liu Wu said, "I don't have anything to do today, so I will go to the town with you to take a look. Watch the fun!" The two drove the carriage to the town quickly. He and Liu Wu wandered around the street and found a bank to exchange the banknotes for small denominations. Lao Cai and Liu Wu said, "Brother Liu Wu, I want to see what business can be done. Do you have any suggestions?" Liu Wu said, "I don't know about business!" Lao Cai laughed and didn't say much, and Lao Cai bought a lot of daily necessities. , bought a lot of food, and the carriage was fully loaded when he came back. When he arrived at Liu Wu's house, Lao Cai said, "Brother Liu Wu! Call your wife, come to our place to eat today, and let your wife teach my wife how to cook!" Liu Wu said, "Okay! I'll go in and call my wife, please wait for us!" He ran in and took his wife with him in no time. When they came out, the two got on the carriage. Lao Cai raised his whip and the carriage headed towards the west end of the village. It soon arrived at the entrance of the small courtyard. Gao Birou and Zhuo Ran were playing in the yard. When the carriage arrived at the door, the two of them also walked out. When Sister Cui saw Gao Birou coming out, she said, "Cousin! I'll come over and cook with you today!" Gao Birou was worrying about how to cook, and it was like seeing a savior! He kept saying, "This is great!" What you want! "Xiao Zhuoran had already helped to take the things from the carriage into the yard. Lao Cai took the food to the kitchen. He came out and said to Gao Birou, "Madam, you don't need to be busy here. Go to the kitchen with your cousin!" "
Sister Cui took Gao Birou's hand and walked towards the kitchen, saying as she walked, "Sister! Today, sister will teach you how to do itmeal! Gao Birou said, "I will study hard today!" "Xiao Zhuoran followed Lao Cai and Liu Wu and took the things from the carriage into the room. Lao Cai looked at Xiao Zhuoran and touched his head lovingly, with his eyes full of care! Soon everything was moved down and put away. Lao Cai made a pot of tea, and he and Liu Wu drank tea leisurely, while Xiao Zhuoran ran to the yard to play by himself. Lao Cai said, "Brother Liu Wu! You should help me find out what I'm telling you as soon as possible. You are familiar with this place, but we are not. We have settled here, and we have to find a way to support ourselves! Even though we have some money in our hands, we can’t sit back and rest in vain! "Liu Wu took a sip of tea and said, "Brother Cai, don't worry, I will try my best to handle this matter. If you still want to do some business in the town, you can talk to my brother when you have time! "The two chatted while drinking tea. Xiao Zhuoran ran to the room and then to the kitchen, having a lot of fun! In the kitchen, Gao Birou followed Sister Cui and humbly learned how to cook. Sister Cui also took the trouble to tell her how to make braised chicken nuggets. Xiao Zhuoran also took the trouble to tell her how to make braised chicken nuggets. How to make fried meat? She actually asked Gao Birou to make scrambled eggs. This made Gao Birou a little excited, as if she had made something delicious! Lao Cai and Liu Wu smiled at each other when they heard the sound from the kitchen, and they actually started to argue about the quality of wine!
Just then, Sister Cui came in with a pot of braised chicken nuggets, and the aroma instantly filled the room. Gao Birou then brought the scrambled eggs, and she said to the two of them, "I scrambled these eggs, you must try them later!" Soon there were six dishes on the table, and Sister Cui said, "You can start eating!" "Lao Cai and Liu Wu naturally brought the wine and poured it. Gao Birou and sister Cui came and sat down at this time. Xiao Zhuoran also sat beside his mother seriously. Gao Birou put a piece of chicken into Zhuo Ran's bowl. Lao Cai raised his glass and toasted Liu Wu. Gao Birou and Cui Sister Cui did not drink today, and each of them had a bowl of rice. Gao Birou ate this meal very well, because she felt that she had made great progress. There was one dish in it, scrambled eggs, which she made by herself under the guidance of Sister Cui, which gave her a sense of accomplishment. Anyway, she ate very deliciously!
After eating, Gao Birou and Sister Cui tidied up together, and then Sister Cui started chatting with Gao Birou. Gao Birou was becoming more and more fond of the carefree Sister Cui! While chatting with Sister Cui, she watched Zhuo Ran playing in the yard. Lao Cai and Liu Wu chatted for a while, then stood up to say goodbye and left with Sister Cui who still wanted to talk. He wanted to find someone to find out who had land to sell, because he promised Lao Cai!
